_comment: Physics settings of the alkali ns->np extrapolation model. Editing a value that enters params_hash makes the shipped tables stale; the module then uses the exact backend until the tables are rebuilt.
np_cutoff: rc[1] tuned to lowest np (J average)

Li.note: singor_rc is a placeholder, not from Singor

Fr.note: Derived for LiNaK: Marinescu s and p parameters fitted to the NIST levels; SO scale from the 7p splitting; lam = 1; Fr+ alpha_D from RRPA; the dipole cutoff rc (4.2) fitted to the Roberts-Fairhall-Ginges 7s-7p and 7s-8p matrix elements (no measured Fr threshold or high-n anchor exists)
